history.summary: Created cuentas-admin@v1 as a planning draft with all twelve sections, nine views, 34 visual acceptance criteria and five explicit owner questions. Created its self-contained responsive HTML mockup using Pictures tokens, light/dark themes and visible view/state/dialog controls. Approval remains with the owner and plan; no production code was changed.

questions: What legal entity name, privacy-policy URL and rights-contact email should replace the notice placeholders, and can David approve notice v1 after Sempertex legal review?
Should administrators regenerate expired/lost invitations, and should replacement invitation/reset links invalidate every older unused link of the same kind?
When an account is deleted, what happens to its projects, personal decorations and attributable AI-spend records, and what irreversible-loss copy should be shown?
May custom roles have zero permissions, or should the proposed minimum of one permission apply?
After invitation activation, should the person explicitly sign in as proposed, or receive a session immediately?
